thesis: With Bitcoin, a fleet of AI agents and cryptographic governance, anyone can do what used to need the permission of a corporation, bank, platform or state.

pillars.role: Move value: identity, entities, Bitcoin settlement, the economy that remembers need.
Get the work done: a captain over a fleet of agents, with verification and approval built in — and the people, commitments and spending the work runs on.
Coordinate without a coercive state: signed voting, transparent treasury, rules people can recount.

projects.name: loki
projects.what: Loki is an independent product for building and changing projects with AI agents. Start with a brief, create a real repository, build and deploy, then use project feedback to direct the next change. OrangeCat linking is optional; an OrangeCat account is not required to build in Loki.
projects.stack: Next.js 16 App Router · TypeScript strict · Tailwind 4 + ui-* design system (globals.css SSOT) · Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL 17 (self-hosted Hetzner) · box-runner + Fleet Runner desktop (Electron, node-pty) · pgvector fleet-knowledge RAG (fastembed 384-dim) · Auth.js (GitHub/Google/X/email + OrangeCat OIDC)

identity.problem: Builders need a trustworthy command center for AI agents to manage multiple projects simultaneously
identity.solution: Loki provides a multi-user SaaS platform for commanding AI agent fleets across projects, with a focus on control, simplicity, and security
identity.mission: Direct the creation of everything you can imagine. Loki is the control plane for the age of autonomous creation: today one person commands a fleet of AI agents building software, tomorrow the same person commands fleets of robots building the physical world. Raw capability is no longer the constraint — human direction is. Every surface exists to raise the number of agents one operator can hold in their head and aim.
identity.vision: Leverage shifts from companies to individuals: a single builder, on their own machines and their own models, out-executes a team, and the only remaining bottleneck is their judgment about what to build. Deliberately open- and local-model capable, so creation is never gated behind closed frontier subscriptions. The commercial form — a high-retention SaaS for builders and small teams, with OrangeCat as the economic layer — follows from that goal rather than defining it.

projects.name: orangecat
projects.what: Your AI economic agent — and the platform where it operates.
projects.stack: Next.js 15 · TypeScript · Supabase (self-hosted on the bitbaum box) · BTC/Lightning (NWC, LNURL, Alby) · pgvector (Cat memory) · Groq + OpenRouter BYOK · OIDC provider (PKCE, JWKS, refresh rotation)

identity.problem: Economic participation is currently limited by gatekeepers, making it difficult for individuals and organizations to participate in the economy without restrictions.
identity.solution: OrangeCat provides an AI-native platform for universal economic participation, allowing users to manage their economic activity with full control and autonomy.
identity.mission: To enable universal economic participation by removing gatekeepers and allowing pseudonymous participation, with AI agents that can transact on behalf of users.
identity.vision: To become a platform where anyone can participate in the economy, regardless of identity or location, with full control over their economic activity.

projects.name: solon
projects.what: Governance any group can use — one-click proposals and votes for anyone with an account (Solon's own, or OrangeCat's), Bitcoin signatures for anyone who wants a vote others can recount without trusting Solon, versioned policies and an append-only audit trail.

identity.problem: Lack of transparency and security in traditional governance and treasury management systems
identity.solution: Solon provides a blockchain-based platform for transparent and secure governance and treasury management, using cryptographic methods and Bitcoin-native technology
identity.mission: Solon aims to provide verifiable governance, replacing trust with math and enabling transparent decision-making and treasury management.
identity.vision: Solon envisions a future where governance is transparent, auditable, and secure, using blockchain technology and cryptographic methods.

projects.name: Causius
projects.what: The legal layer of the fleet: an agent that does legal work on a sealed case file, a person who decides what leaves it, and licensed lawyers where the law reserves the work for them. Read a letter without an account, or open a matter and let the agent research, keep the deadlines and draft.

identity.problem: Legal marketplaces rot the same way: clients want cheaper and faster, platforms attract hungry lawyers rather than the good ones, quality and trust fall, and AI on top just industrialises mediocre memos. Meanwhile Swiss SME employment and contract matters are frequent, document-heavy and repeat, yet each reaches a lawyer as an unstructured pile the lawyer bills hours to untangle.
identity.solution: Causius prepares the mandate. A licensed lawyer owns it. Intake turns a messy SME employment or contract matter into a structured file: timeline, clause map, missing documents, first draft and a risk list with citations to Fedlex and case law. A curated bench of named lawyers accepts, edits and bills it. A factory for prepared files, not a lawyer directory or a substitute counsel; it never says 'you should sue'.

projects.name: datacat
projects.what: Universal AI-powered data ingestion and form builder platform.

identity.problem: Data ingestion and analysis are domain-specific and often require custom solutions, leading to inefficiencies and inconsistencies.
identity.solution: DataCat provides a domain-agnostic pipeline for data ingestion and analysis, using AI-powered engines and a unified schema.
identity.mission: DataCat solves the problem of data ingestion and analysis for various domains by providing a domain-agnostic pipeline.
identity.vision: DataCat aims to become a leading platform for data ingestion and analysis, applicable to multiple domains and industries.

projects.name: Diplodoctor
projects.what: The health layer of the fleet: an agent that reads a medical report with you, a person who decides what leaves it, and the people they choose to help: assistants anyone can be, and licensed professionals where the law reserves the work for them. Paste or photograph a lab report and see every value, which ones are outside their printed range, what they measure and what to ask your doctor. Read it without an account, in five languages. An account is there for what comes next (people you choose, matters), not for the reading.

identity.problem: A lab report reaches the person it is about as a page of values, units and printed ranges that they usually cannot read on their own.
identity.solution: Paste or photograph a lab report and see every value, which ones are outside their printed range, what they measure and what to ask your doctor, without an account and in five languages. The AI reads and explains but never diagnoses or prescribes; health assistants anyone can be, and licensed professionals where the law reserves the work, help with the rest.
identity.mission: Help anyone understand their own medical results, with the person deciding what leaves them and who helps.
identity.vision: Three kinds of help in one place: any AI model, health assistants, and licensed professionals who can prove their licence without revealing who they are, each saying only what they are allowed to say.

projects.name: evig
projects.what: evig makes genuinely good computing affordable to everyone — curated, decent hardware people actually want to use, not junk refurb. Founded 2026. This repository is the platform that runs it: a storefront, a community marketplace, repair & IT-help, workshops, an AI-assisted intake pipeline, and an in-house AI assistant.

identity.problem: Electronic waste and lack of access to technology for those in need.
identity.solution: evig provides refurbished technology to those in need, while promoting sustainability and digital inclusion.
identity.mission: To provide refurbished technology to those in need, while promoting sustainability and digital inclusion.
identity.vision: A world where technology is accessible to all, and electronic waste is minimized.

projects.name: Heidi
projects.what: Helps adults who already speak German understand the Zurich German actually spoken around them. Runs at heidi.orangecat.ch (beta).

identity.problem: An adult who already commands German still cannot understand the Zurich German spoken around them, and the environment withdraws exposure exactly when it detects they need it: the Swiss switch to Hochdeutsch or English the moment they notice you struggling. The learner is denied the input because they are a learner. That trap is the reason a product is justified at all.
identity.solution: A source of exposure that does not withdraw. Raw exposure is not input, so the job is calibrated exposure at the learner's frontier, measured per learner and continuously — the thing software can do that a podcast cannot. Real recorded speakers, plus a deterministic variety gate, because a learner buying Zurich German cannot audit whether they were handed Bernese forms.
identity.mission: Help an adult who already has German understand the Zurich German actually spoken around them, deal with the messages and speech they meet in real life, and turn those encounters into learning.
identity.vision: Progress measured by how much of an unfamiliar Zurich speaker the learner understands — not by how much Heidi they have consumed.

projects.name: petvity
projects.what: Global pet care platform — owners manage multi-species pet profiles, track physical and emotional health KPIs, connect with vets and sitters, access a marketplace, and list pets for adoption.

identity.problem: Pet owners need a single place to monitor their pet's daily wellness and manage the full care journey
identity.solution: Petvity provides a platform for pet owners to manage multi-species pet profiles, track physical and emotional health KPIs, and connect with vets and sitters
identity.mission: Petvity gives pet owners a single place to monitor their pet's daily wellness, connect with local vets and sitters, and manage the full care journey.
identity.vision: Long-term vision: digital twins (IoT sensors, cameras, emotional state) as part of the same ecosystem as Vita and Surf Your Life.

projects.name: revamp-info
projects.what: Hirnli helps mission-driven organizations find the right foundation funders, build per-foundation fit narratives, and ship professional German-language applications (Gesuche) that stand out from the templated norm. Multi-tenant by design — one deployment serves each organization's branded site on its own host.

identity.problem: Foundations receive hundreds of applications, most of which are plain text templates that look the same, making it hard for organizations to stand out
identity.solution: Generate professional, visually compelling, and data-rich application documents that demonstrate fit and transparency
identity.mission: Revamp-IT's survival depends on foundation grants — this platform exists to find the right foundations, build compelling evidence of fit, and generate professional Gesuche that win funding.
identity.vision: To become a standalone SaaS product that helps any purpose-driven organization present themselves compellingly to potential funders and generate professional application documents.

projects.name: substrata
projects.what: Open-source research on the physical chokepoints between here and a much faster technological progress.
projects.stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL 17, OrangeCat OIDC, @bitbaum/ai-kit, bip-kit and sitekit. Versioned research corpus; derived search, atlas and exports.

identity.problem: Critical technology chains are difficult to understand and verify. Sources, companies, bottlenecks and analyst judgements are scattered, and practitioners lack a simple way to correct the record.
identity.solution: An open research map joining bottlenecks, producers, science, policy, capital and talent, with evidence links, visual exploration, searchable explanations and a dedicated content contribution inbox.
identity.mission: Make the physical constraints on technological progress understandable, checkable and open to correction by people who know the work.
identity.vision: A collaborative research service where anyone can follow a technology chain, inspect the evidence behind a claim, personalise their learning and contribute expertise that improves a shared public map.

projects.name: surf-your-life
projects.what: A psychiatry-led clinic portal (Zürich) helping people recover from burnout and Long COVID. Clients track their recovery — daily check-ins, symptoms, sleep, techniques — and practitioners get the visibility they need to intervene early, run evidence-based programs, and analyze progress.

identity.problem: People struggling with burnout and Long COVID lack a structured way to track their recovery, and practitioners lack visibility to intervene early.
identity.solution: A health portal providing daily check-ins, symptom tracking, and progress analysis, with AI-powered insights for practitioners.
identity.mission: To give clients a structured way to track their recovery and practitioners the visibility to intervene early, run evidence-based programs, and analyze progress.
identity.vision: To become a comprehensive health portal for burnout/Long-COVID reintegration and longevity, with AI analysis of structured and unstructured data.

projects.name: sink
projects.what: Portfolio site for S.Ink — tattoo work by Sami Tutar. Fine line, blackwork, lettering, ornamental. Available in seven languages.

projects.name: sbb-lost-found
projects.what: Report something lost on a train while you are still on it, bound to the actual journey, so staff can search before the vehicle reaches the depot.

identity.problem: The current lost and found process in Swiss public transport has a low recovery rate due to the time delay between reporting a lost item and the train staff receiving the notification
identity.solution: A real-time platform that allows passengers to report lost items and train staff to receive notifications while the item is still on board, increasing the recovery rate
identity.mission: To increase the recovery rate of lost items in Swiss public transport by providing a real-time platform for passengers to report lost items and for train staff to receive notifications.
identity.vision: To become the standard solution for lost and found in Swiss public transport, making it easier for passengers to recover their lost items and reducing the workload for train staff.

projects.name: botsmann
projects.what: Domain-specialized AI professionals, not another generic chatbot wrapper.

identity.problem: Users need expert advice and guidance in various domains, but generic chatbots often lack the necessary specialized knowledge and context.
identity.solution: Botsmann provides domain-specialized AI professionals with scoped knowledge and domain-specific system prompts, offering users expert advice and guidance.
identity.mission: Botsmann solves the problem of generic chatbot limitations by providing specialized AI professionals for various domains, serving users who need expert advice and guidance.
identity.vision: Botsmann aims to become a leading platform for domain-specialized AI professionals, offering a wide range of experts and services to users.

projects.name: Skif
projects.what: Holistic safety for people and the places they live — Zürich first, without trading away privacy or freedom.

identity.problem: Security firms sell equipment, not outcomes: cloud cameras, CCTV, alarm subscriptions, now facial recognition, on the assumption that more surveillance means more safety. The data leaves the home, sits with a vendor and can be shared without the person deciding. Human protection is bouncers picked for size, or close protection that is costly, opaque and not bookable. Nobody measures whether it worked, and nobody says 'you don't need to buy anything'.
identity.solution: The person first states what they value and their limits: a Safety Preference Profile with hard constraints (no facial recognition, no interior cameras, no cloud video, no automatic police sharing). Each recommendation is the most proportionate effective intervention within those limits, trade-offs shown, never one opaque score; 'buy nothing' is valid. Protectors are chosen for judgment and calm, not intimidation, and matching explains why. Everyone sees only what the job needs.
